Wynn Resorts LTD (WYNN) Stock Price Rose While Capital Impact Advisors Has Trimmed Its Holding; Apple (AAPL) Holding Upped by Cortland Associates Inc
June 27, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Capital Impact Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Wynn Resorts Ltd (WYNN) by 24.33% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Impact Advisors Llc sold 3,663 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.92% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 11,394 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.08M, down from 15,057 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Impact Advisors Llc who had been investing in Wynn Resorts Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $18.21B market cap company. The stock increased 0.31% or $0.51 during the last trading session, reaching $167.71. About 671,340 shares traded. Wynn Resorts, Limited (NASDAQ:WYNN) has risen 56.07% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 43.50% the S&P500.
